full_page.content:
1948, February
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Bles'd be God in all His designs!
Febr. 18th, '48
God bless you Sister Miriam James --
You and your community. Yes we quite enjoyed our visit to Portland and out to your ideally located Mother house in Marylhurst - on our way to San Francisco and Los Angeles ....... We are sending in separate cover book- lets pertaining to wonderful source of blessings, the Seraphic Mass Association. I am enrolling your dear Mother too in the Emergence list for the intention that she speedily improve in health - physically, mentally, spiritually. I hope she give the doctors a surprise.
God's grace and blessing to all Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
P.S. Yesterday received letter from Fr. Maurice E. Joachim and To-day one from Fr. E'd. Both seem feel- ing well. Deo Gratias!
Sr. Miriam James February 14, 1948
"God bless you Sister Miriam James." Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. "God condescends to use our powers if we don't spoil His plans by ours."
( quote from) Mgr. Edw'd F. Casey
Originals in possession of: Sister Bernadine Casey, S.N.J.M. Fort Wright College W. 4000 Randolph Rd. Spokane, Wa. 99204
